title: Microsoft Purview: Priority cleanup to permanently delete Exchange mailbox items under holds (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the licensing uncertainty overlooks Microsoft's explicit rules for users with Purview roles and users whose mailboxes a policy covers. The approver-role summary also omits mandatory additional roles, which can cause policy creation to fail.
